explication: Patchy is a cross-platform, PSD-oriented image editor. An artist or local AI agent opens an image through the application entry point, edits a layered document with canvas tools, brushes, selections, vectors, masks, smart objects, and effects, then renders and saves it through the format system. JavaScript and MCP provide automation paths into the same document services. The tree and excerpts establish the core, filter, scripting, selection, and entry-point layers; several UI and format relationships remain inferred from documented capabilities.
